r3_note: Pass 2. Transcript traps used in the rulings: (1) at [19:14]-[19:19] the engine wrote 'etna' then 'hamasna' - the t of t7ammasna is very likely absorbed into 'etna' (i7na), so D3 stays a B row only; (2) at [1:09:04] the engine merged two Amal lines - 'يعطيك ألف عافية' is her farewell and 'الله يعافيكي بس' is her reply to his untranscribed attempt at [1:09:06]; (3) Arabic-script رجله is the ordinary spelling of Levantine ijr-o (root r-j-l), not evidence of Fusha rijl - he says 'ijrik' himself at [1:01:42]; (4) her chat lines in this lesson routinely transcribe the whole target sentence, so a chat line alone is not a fix signal. D13 and D14 are the same slip (dangling 'to' -> lawain) - D13 carries the final row, D14 dropped as its duplicate. Merger should check the agreed list has the [06:28]-[06:40] moment (his 'lazem tseer' rejected with 'أنا لازم تصير؟ No' and recast a5alliha t9eer) and the [32:28]-[32:31] verb-gender fix (بيوجع -> بتوجع after 'is feminine'); neither was in the disputes so I assume they are agreed. Sheet has no ashyaa2, no kammel/continue, no lawain - the tier-0 rows are genuine didn't-knows.
